text: Ooh, a captain! A real one, with a real ship? Welcome, welcome!
Nessa's Notions: rope, salt, citrus, and things I promise are not stolen.

menu.text: What can Nessa do for you?

text: Honestly? Not much yet. Supply ship's late. Again.
When the stalls fill up I'll trade you blades, charms, the works. Bring me banked treasure and we'll talk.
Gold's gold. Treasure's better. But only what's banked on your ship counts. What's in your pockets is just a promise.
Last I heard you'd stowed {banked} pieces. Keep it up!
Wren swears there's a stash hidden in the jungle west of the ruins. Wren also swears the moon owes her money.
There's supposed to be something shiny up by the lighthouse, too. Ambrose won't say what.

bye.text: Come back rich! Or at least come back.
